# T-2: Move workflow commands

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Move workflow command runtime ownership to the workflow plugin while preserving existing public add/update/show/search/list/publish behavior and adding ideas as the issue-log review command.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R2, R3, R9, AC2, AC4, AC5, and AC14 are covered.
- Workflow plugin commands return Envelope-compatible objects and validate entry-point arguments.
- No workflow plugin command imports core src/workflow modules.

## Implementation Notes
Port command classes and shared helpers into the plugin. Keep subcommands internal to the workflow plugin; core only sees the top-level plugin command.

## Test Strategy
Plugin repo tests cover command dispatch, argument validation, command envelopes, removed subcommands, and ideas --spec validation.
